newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia Istrabenz sees steady 96 net.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia Istrabenz sees steady 96 net.

text.p: Slovenian petrol trading company Istrabenz said on Tuesday 1996 net profit was expected to remain unchanged from the 784 million tolars ($5.2 million) posted in 1995 due to low petrol prices.
The company said it planned to pay a dividend for the first time but added the value of the dividend would be determined at the shareholders' meeting in May.
The company said sales were expected to grow in all business areas as trading volume at its subsidiaries was up by between four and 31 percent.
Shares of Istrabenz, which were listed on the over-the-counter market of the Ljubljana bourse on Monday, on Tuesday eased 4.1 percent to 3,548 tolars on volume of 32,118 shares.
